definition: Test whether an opt-in GM survey measures activity, tooluse, market population or regionalmap/export demand.
unit: responses; percentages of answers to each question; exact per-question n unknown
geography_language: English recruitment; no geographic/language weighting established
population_or_sampling_frame: Voluntary Dispatch readers and Daggerheart subreddit respondents, not all DH GMs.
availability_and_access: Public primary aggregate article; no raw rows or per-question denominators supplied in read scope.
deduplication: One study and publisher; recruitment channels not separate samples. Different question percentages not distinct people.
biases: Self-selection via publication and subreddit; not a representative market frame.
Exact per-question n and row-level respondent IDs/cross-tabs not supplied in the read article.
Self-reported recency is not verified sessions or annual survival. No count is inferred by multiplying987 by a percentage.
Content/homebrew preference and map-tool choices do not distinguish new regionalhex creation, battle maps or prepared-setting use.
No switching/export unmet-need question identified; existing tool use does not prove willingness to switch.
target_variable: Can evidence support M/p/T calibration or a destination-specific product hypothesis?
calibration_or_qualitative_only: Qualitative only; no numerical weight or active method conversion.
uncertainty: Sampling/recruitment/answer denominators/overlap; GM-role self-report, relative recency.

validation_or_falsification.input: Methods specify GM-oriented recruitment,collectiondates and response count

validation_or_falsification.expected: use as relative self-reported recency, never annualGM total
validation_or_falsification.observed: per-question n unknown; no population sampling frame

validation_or_falsification.expected: identify an existing destination, not additive audiences
validation_or_falsification.observed: questions overlap; no row-level pairing. Never add27.3 and23.5

validation_or_falsification.expected: do not substitute for newregionalhex p_create
validation_or_falsification.observed: does not define map scale/type or new-vs-ready geography

validation_or_falsification.expected: require unmet export/switch evidence before demand conversion
validation_or_falsification.observed: no such question identified in read article
unanswered questions excluded, denominators not published

new_signal_definition: gm_survey_experimental: self-reported activity/tool responses with explicit period and question denominator; proposed experimental collection type only.
tested_conclusion: Useful for role/recency and destination context; fails globalM, p_create, T and converter-demand calibration.
product_consequence: Scope029 as optional one-way snapshot hypothesis; no fullsync or claim that its market is27.3% of all GMs.
